description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for formatting HTTP request and response messages into log strings using variable substitution templates. It includes constants for different log formats and a method to generate formatted log messages based on request, response, and error data.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats HTTP messages into log strings using variable substitution templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with a specified template or default format.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log message string based on the provided request, response, and error.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Helper method to extract headers from a message as a string.
